<local-command-stdout>## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Necessary] Several `Key changes` bullets spell out the content and consequences of the new rules this PR adds to `pr-guidelines.md` (e.g. the Fix/Note severity definition, the Scoped "hunk sits inside the stated intent" test, the Grounded derivation rule) — exactly what the PR's own newly-added Necessary bullet forbids ("spelling out what an added rule, definition, or table row says is detail... whether quoted, summarized, or given with its consequence"). A reviewer applying the new rule to the body finds the body itself in violation.
- [Grounded] The Verification checklist's absence claim "No rule belongs to two properties" doesn't show a runnable query/command the way its sibling items do (which cite `diff` exit codes or `grep -c` commands), even though the PR's own newly-added Grounded rule requires an absence claim to show "the query it rests on and the scope it examined."

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] The clause-mapping claim ("covering the 37 rule bullets the reformat carried over, with every clause landing at exactly one destination and none dropped or duplicated") rests on `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which the body itself says is gitignored and checkable only on the authoring machine, not from a clone. (Independently, the headline count of 37 top-level bullets across the five property sections at the merge base was reproduced and matches.)

### Property walk
- Decidable: body reads top-down (Purpose → Key changes → Verification) and each Key-changes bullet nests its own rationale beneath a top-level claim, matching the new nesting rule it introduces.
- Grounded: extensively checked and largely confirmed — the 45-top-level/0-nested bullet count for `pr-guidelines.md`, its status as the largest flat list among the 17 files, the 37-bullet total across the five sections, and the byte-identical property-list and template blocks against the merge base all verified; one Note above on an unsupported absence claim.
- Necessary: one Note above — several bullets restate new-rule content/consequences that the PR's own new Necessary bullet forbids.
- Scoped: all three touched files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) are accounted for in the body; no unexplained hunks found.
- Conformant: title is a single 57-character line, no auto-close keywords, checkbox usage is correct, and no hard-wrap violations were found (the updated parser correctly excludes the body's own nested list items).

### Verdict
PASS</local-command-stdout>
